verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is the SOC 2 Launchpad guide, which says users generate a blueprint and "action policies" (sprinto-docs-6, sprinto-docs-20). That implies policy management exists inside the platform's governance setup but describes none of the specific capabilities. Missing for 10: lawyer-grade policy template library, policy editor, version history, approval workflows, per-employee acceptance tracking, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
